title: When Is an Image Enough? A Checkpoint-Level Decidability Benchmark and Rule-Conditioned Evidence-Sufficiency Analysis for Visual Compliance
description: R-CES benchmark annotations, codebook, evaluation code and an image-free score archive for verifying the ACML 2026 paper tables. Source photographs are hosted separately by upstream ARGus. Code: MIT; annotations and result data: CC BY 4.0.
